The planned correspondence-theorem route was therefore not taken and thm-correspondence-theorem-groups was removed as unused. The surviving Dedekind lemma is earlier on the same page, and the second isomorphism theorem is published on an earlier page.

That theorem is published on construction-of-the-natural-numbers at order 6, strictly before this page at order 66.

The proof never needed the construction clauses of def-quotient-group: surjectivity plus derived-series functoriality directly gives (G/N)^(n)=q(G^(n))=1. The replacement proposition is published on normal-subgroups-and-quotient-groups at order 34, strictly before order 66.

This dependency is an earlier item on the same order-66 A page and therefore precedes the theorem in page reading order.

The replacement theorem is published on cyclic-groups-and-direct-products at order 38, strictly before the example page at order 67. The item later received a step-6 text repair, but this dependency substitution already appears in the step-5 authoring report.

Thus the two added dependencies establish A4'=V4, and thm-finite-solvable-iff-composition-factors-have-prime-order was removed because solvability follows directly from S4'=A4, A4'=V4, and V4'=1. The quotient criterion is published at order 34; the characteristic-derived-subgroup theorem is on the order-66 A page, which precedes this order-67 companion page.

Those explicit small-group calculations already show that kernel and quotient are nontrivial abelian, hence nilpotent of class one, so the planned full classification of cyclic groups was not used and thm-classification-of-cyclic-groups was removed.

The replacement definition is published on modules-and-module-homomorphisms at order 102, strictly before order 104.
